summary: The claim and proof are valid. Small and degenerate supports, missing ranks, arbitrary positive profiles, open convex sets, and empty partition halves introduce no exception. Convexity and permutation invariance give precisely the initial orbit intervals at every present lower rank. The counting identities, antipodal depth estimates, and Holder comparisons are correct. The full combinatorial sums imported from the accepted predecessor have the same indices, spatial dimension, and normalization after the explicit cutoff and symbol maps. Reflection preserves the actual ambient depths, and the conditional-law comparison supplies the stated factor of one eighth without changing the original law or ambient space.
